> S98 (2026-06-26) The self-watch digest stops dropping the detail the organism already recorded. SHIPPED + AUTO-DEPLOYED + VERIFIED LIVE (signals bed2006 + 7737a9b, both auto-deployed via the S96 deploy-on-push workflow and self-smoked green). /goal /arc -> one continuous mission, direct push to main. Re-audited S97 vs LIVE FIRST: SOUND — smoke 42/42 (mind.api_sane -> mind_open=8/8 open=9); /api/version ef7a05ed (stamped) = the last DEPLOYABLE signal (HEAD e1e7f77 was the S97 closeout chore, context/docs only, correctly path-filtered out of deploy-on-push — live sha trailing HEAD by one docs-only signal is correct, not a stale deploy). The em-dash 'mojibake' in /api/vigilance.critic.latest was a local curl|python Windows stdin-decode artifact; the served bytes are correct UTF-8 E2 80 94 (verified by hexdump). No finding. KEYSTONE D-S98.1 (digest detail legibility — a CANON-031 lying-surface-by-omission, the S97/S90 vein): /api/vigilance.recent_activity reported each self-generated organ's 24h activity, but recentReactivity read only payload.observation || payload.prescription for the per-organ latest, and most_recent.detail fell back to a GENERIC ORGAN_VERB. So Dreaming's study events, Memory's REM consolidation, and a promoted reflex read latest:null / 'consolidated its memory' — even though their payloads carry SPECIFIC, human-renderable detail (which study target; how many moments of what kind consolidated). Only the critic rendered, because S90 special-cased an observation field onto its payload precisely to feed this digest. A consumer of /api/vigilance (a human on /organism, a polling AI agent) read 'Dreaming: 2 acts, latest: null' and reasonably concluded the organ produces nothing describable — false; the organism recorded exactly what it did. FIX: a pure, payload-aware organEventDetail(event, organ) (src/worker/vigilance.mjs) derives the real detail per eventType (digest-length, measured-only, consistent with chronicle.mjs phrasing); both the per-organ latest (JSON) and most_recent.detail (JSON + the /organism & /status HTML) route through it; ORGAN_VERB is the honest empty-payload fallback only. NOT GAMING: pure read, mutates no state/number, fabricates nothing — can only make the surface MORE truthful. Verified live (bed2006): dream -> 'my study of wisdom held — 3 self-measurements', memory -> 'gathered 7 write conflict recovered moments into one kept memory' (both were null). D-S98.1b (second-order): the rich detail was in JSON but the HTML digest chips showed only count+ago; added an accessible title tooltip on each chip (zero layout change, strict-CSP), verified live on /organism + /status (7737a9b). FAMILY SWEEP (the S91 'fix the whole family' lesson): clean — the only other observation||prescription readers are vigilanceReading's reflexes/lessons latest (reactive-organ OBJECTS that carry .observation directly, not archive-event payloads) + the chronicle/ark/capabilities renderers (correct by design); no adjacent consumer drops detail. D-S98.2 (critic-study root cause, carried #1): ANALYZED — runCuriosity (organismTick:288) reseeds via seedCuriosity before the critic lane (506), but seedCuriosity self-gates on wisdom_accreting (live: wisdom rising) so it is NOT the slot-holder; the holder is a directed lane in the single EXCLUSIVE openCuriosityWorld slot (CURIOSITY_STUDY_WINDOW=3). Confirmation is the zero-cost public read /api/vigilance.critic.study_pending at the next full tick (the credential-free surface S97 built; a prod-D1 forensic read to confirm was correctly sandbox-denied — the system agreeing the public surface is the right one); carried as a WATCH (S97's own closeout did the same with its probe). The FIX — a dedicated critic probe lane so the standing structural doubt does not compete with the mind's routine studies for the single slot — is a high-risk single-slot-invariant change (every openCuriosityWorld consumer assumes exclusivity) and is therefore the #1 carried keystone for a DEDICATED session, recorded as an honest defer (a WIN). 1301 -> 1309 tests/0 (+8 tests/phase98-organ-detail-legibility), verify exit 0 (csp 0), worker:check 0, scan-secrets + windows-hide clean, 0 new deps. LESSON: a digest that reports a COUNT while dropping the DETAIL it already holds is the same lying-surface-by-omission class as S97's bare number/null — render every organ from its real payload, never from the one field one organ happened to special-case. And: a slot-starvation root cause diagnosed from code alone produced a wrong theory (seedCuriosity) that the public probe exists to settle — trust the surface S97 lit over the guess; a sandbox denial of prod forensics is the system agreeing.
